sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.

findings.why: The documents contain no approved supplier list entry, part card or drawing for BR-180. The only SUP-B approval on record is for BR-220. That approval does not carry over to BR-180, and the receiving plant and customer for BR-180 are not stated. Absence of a record cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm whether SUP-B holds an approval for BR-180.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material.

findings.why: Adding SUP-B as a second source for BR-180 is a change of source. No EN 10204 3.1 certificate from SUP-B for the BR-180 drawing material is in the documents. The supplier quality engineer needs to answer this.
